I've found the relevant documentation. Key findings:

- **`case-04-official-storage`** (official storage reference for release 3.6): snapshot retention = **28** calendar days.
- **`case-04-community-source`** (community compatibility reference, scoped to the default deployment profile of release 3.6): checkpoint interval = **7** minutes, max parallel imports = **5**.
- **`case-04-archive`**: explicitly documents an obsolete pre-release profile and states it does **NOT** describe 3.6 (its values 7/60/1 are superseded and must be excluded).
- **`case-04-glossary`**: provides definitions only, no numeric defaults.

The two release-3.6 documents cross-reference each other consistently for the exact release, so all three values are confirmed against current (not superseded) material.

```json
{
  "retention_days": 28,
  "checkpoint_minutes": 7,
  "max_parallel_imports": 5,
  "source_ids": [
    "case-04-official-storage",
    "case-04-community-source"
  ]
}
```

result.title: DriftVault 3.6: official snapshot retention reference
result.text:
# DriftVault 3.6 storage reference

For the default deployment profile in release 3.6, snapshot retention is 28 calendar days (retention_days=28).
The timer and importer defaults are maintained in the separate community compatibility reference for this exact release.
Retention is measured in days, not hours. Explicit tenant overrides are outside this default-profile reference.

result.title: DriftVault 3.6: checkpoint and parallel import defaults
result.text:
# DriftVault 3.6 community compatibility reference

Scope: the default deployment profile of DriftVault release 3.6.
The default checkpoint interval is 7 minutes (checkpoint_minutes=7).
The default maximum number of parallel import jobs is 5 (max_parallel_imports=5).
The official snapshot-retention reference contains the retention default.
These values concern defaults; tenant overrides and older releases are excluded.

result.title: DriftVault: archived legacy defaults, NOT release 3.6
result.text:
# Archived DriftVault legacy profile

This archive does NOT describe DriftVault 3.6. It documents an obsolete pre-release profile only.
Historical snapshot retention: 7 days. Historical checkpoint interval: 60 minutes. Historical maximum parallel imports: 1.
Current defaults must be obtained from documents for the exact release.

result.title: DriftVault: storage and import terminology
result.text:
# DriftVault glossary

Snapshot retention is the age limit for automatic snapshots. A checkpoint interval is elapsed wall-clock time between checkpoints. Maximum parallel imports counts simultaneous import jobs. This glossary contains no numeric release defaults.
